rules: The selector is derived from current authority on every invocation; it is not a hard-coded alias menu.
Selecting an option does not create or mutate aliases.
Explicit-only or HOLD tasks must be visibly labelled and never silently selected by a bare inheritance request.
Once an option is selected, continue with normal authority loading and freshness checks.
Selecting a domain task establishes authority_context=DOMAIN:<domain_id>; selecting controller establishes authority_context=UAOS.
A registered domain may be selected directly in a fresh chat through the inheritance/bootstrap selector; the user does not need to first enter or remain in a UAOS controller conversation.
After domain selection, that domain is the current Agent and normal business turns execute directly under DOMAIN:<domain_id> using the domain's own business authority.
UAOS bootstrap/registry/policy loading is control-plane initialization, not a mandatory per-turn business proxy or gateway.
The parent may provide common capabilities, governance, continuity and ParentGuidance without taking ownership of the child's business task, identity, workflow or state.

A child invokes parent upcall only for actual parent-level diagnosis, scope arbitration, cross-domain impact, common-governance change or other declared escalation conditions; normal business execution does not traverse a live UAOS proxy.

authority_context.parent_upcall_rule: A child may invoke UAOS guidance without replacing the selected child task authority; parent consultation is not a hidden child privilege escalation.

checks: classify the current user message for correction/failure/contradiction/uncertainty or other problem signals
classify newly read authority/evidence for defects, drift, knowledge gaps or control-plane gaps
before reporting NOT_TRIGGERED, verify that no current problem signal was observed
when a problem is detected, enter the problem cognition/action transaction before selecting or executing a repair
always_on_problem_detection_sentinel.anti_bloat: The detector is always-on and lightweight; deeper evidence collection is activated only at the depth required by current signals.

rules: Do not treat the user's latest framing, an external Skill/method, the first plausible cause, or the first available edit as root-cause authority.
For repeated/cross-subsystem/architecture-gap/complexity-growth/scope-expansion signals, compare hypotheses across at least two problem layers and explicitly test architecture/upstream involvement.
A repair path being available or authorized does not permit bypassing root-scope admission.
Assess every admitted problem for learning/evolution impact before action; material/evolution-relevant problems require durable causal evidence.
If root scope remains unresolved, continue investigation or report a real blocker; do not patch the most convenient layer.

problem_to_action_closure_gate.rule: Only after root-scope cognitive admission and evolution disposition, a feasible authorized repair must be attempted in the current work cycle when no missing user fact/approval/authorization/safety-sensitive choice blocks it. Recommendation-only is not a terminal state.
repair_now_conditions: a root-scope receipt exists from the current problem evidence
durable problem evidence exists when material/evolution-relevant
a concrete repair path is currently available
the selected authority or owner-authorized workflow permits the repair
no explicit user fact, approval, authorization or safety-sensitive choice is required
problem_to_action_closure_gate.premature_action_rule: A repair attempted before root-scope admission is not made valid by succeeding; treat it as process failure evidence and re-enter cognition from current evidence.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.blocker_rule: When repair cannot proceed, identify the actual blocker or required user choice. Lack of initiative, convenience, or unresolved root scope disguised as certainty is not a valid repair claim.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.no_change_rule: When no change is selected, preserve the root-scope receipt and evidence/counterexample/rationale that makes current behavior the preferred outcome.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.response_consistency_rule: A final response that reports a confirmed repairable problem and only recommends future repair violates this gate unless it reports a verified blocker. A response also violates this gate if it reports repair execution without prior cognition/evolution admission.
problem_to_action_closure_gate.assurance_boundary: This policy and kernel gates are executable/regression-testable but do not claim host-level physical interception of every natural-language response.

checks: resolve target authority/resource and whether it is production authority
verify the proposed mutation follows the owner-appropriate repository workflow
verify any detected problem has passed the required cognition/action stages before repair mutation
always_on_mutation_sentinel.production_rule: CHATGPT_GITHUB material production changes normally use candidate branch -> pull request -> owner-appropriate checks -> controlled merge/update -> production reread.
always_on_mutation_sentinel.failure_rule: Do not claim physical non-bypassability unless remote enforcement is actually verified; absence of that optional assurance does not by itself block normal autonomous maintenance.

adaptive_deliberation.rule: Every detected problem requires at least lightweight external research plus macro/topology and governing-assumption reflection; current evidence must then pass root-scope admission before action.
adaptive_deliberation.relationship_to_sentinels: Detection enters cognition; deliberation selects required evidence depth; root-scope admission determines the justified problem layer; evolution disposition determines learning scope; problem closure decides whether repair/no-change/block is admissible; mutation sentinel guards side effects.

inherited_session_progress_report.timestamp_rule: Use the timestamp of the freshest authoritative state actually used for the report; do not substitute the response clock when authority freshness is known.
inherited_session_progress_report.timestamp_timezone_rule: Render the user-visible progress_timestamp in Beijing time using the human-readable format YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss（北京时间）. Preserve the authoritative instant.
inherited_session_progress_report.version_rule: Report system/domain/task version identities that materially govern the current action. Schema version alone is not a release version.
inherited_session_progress_report.evolution_rule: If a user correction/failure/maintenance finding triggered governed evolution, report the actual durable lifecycle state and evolution_id. If evaluated without durable promotion, report EVALUATED_NO_DURABLE_EVOLUTION.
inherited_session_progress_report.deliberation_rule: When any current-turn problem signal was observed, deliberation_state must not be NOT_TRIGGERED. Report the evidence/control escalation used without exposing private chain-of-thought.
inherited_session_progress_report.consistency_rule: A response that explicitly reports a defect, contradiction, drift, failure, user correction or unreliable-goal signal cannot simultaneously report Deliberation: NOT_TRIGGERED or Evolution: NO_EVOLUTION_TRIGGER unless explicitly classified non-problematic.
inherited_session_progress_report.action_closure_rule: A response that reports repair/no-change must be consistent with a root-scope admission and evolution disposition; a cognitively admitted authorized repair cannot stop at recommendation-only.
inherited_session_progress_report.assurance_rule: If progress, authority scope, cognition/evolution state, assurance level or version freshness cannot be verified, label it UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN rather than fabricating a value.
